Following the implementation of the fix, we have completed a period of monitoring and have confirmed that the issue affecting authentication with the Jira integration has been fully resolved, with no further errors observed.

Users should ensure they have reauthenticated with Jira within TestRail to maintain normal functionality.

Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.
